map.：算法：取三点 P1、P2、P3（x,y,z），构造向量 v1=P2−P1、v2: : Algorithm: take three points P1, P2, P3 (x,y,z), build vectors v1=P2−P1, v2=P3−P1, normal n=v1×v2 oriented upward (C>0). Dip = arccos(C/|n|); dip azimuth dipDir=atan2(A,B) (east, north components, normalized to 0~360°); strike = (dipDir−90) mod 360 (equivalent to strike+180). Collinear or horizontal points give no determinate attitude.
map.三点必须严格在同一层面吗？: Must the three points lie strictly on the same plane?
map.必须位于同一构造面，否则算出的法向量是三点拟合面而非真实层面。若三点被断层错开或: The three points must lie on the same structural plane, otherwise the computed normal is the three-point fitted plane rather than the true bedding. If the points are offset by a fault or belong to different lithologic boundaries, results are distorted; confirm stratigraphic continuity in the field first.
map.走向为什么给出两个值？: Why does strike give two values?
map.走向是层面与水平面交线的方向，一条线有两个相反方位（相差 180°），故 str: Strike is the direction of the line where the bedding plane meets the horizontal plane; a line has two opposite directions (180° apart), so strike and strike+180 are equivalent; what actually indicates the "dip direction" is the dip direction dipDir, which differs from strike by 90°.
